name: Band Overhead Pallof Press
steps: Stand sideways to a chest-height band anchor, clasp the band with both hands against your sternum, and step out until the band feels taut.
Press your hands straight out in front of your chest with locked elbows while resisting the sideways pull.
Keeping your arms straight and core braced tightly, raise both hands smoothly overhead.
Lower your hands back down and into your chest, then turn around and switch sides after finishing one side.
tips: Keep your ribs tucked down over your pelvis as your arms rise overhead.
Keep your hips and shoulders facing strictly forward without twisting toward the anchor.
